excel.step1Desc: Open it in Excel and write one product per row, keeping the column order. Delete the two example rows. Categories and units that do not exist yet are created when you save. If you use the CSV template, save it again as CSV.
excel.step2Desc: Choose the CSV (.csv) or Excel (.xlsx) file with your products (max. 500 rows).
excel.rowLimitWarning: Warning: the file has more than 500 rows. Only the first 500 will be processed.
excel.errorSkuDupDb: SKU already exists in database (active or deleted product)
excel.errorPriceInvalid: Selling price is required and must be a number >= 0
excel.errorStockInvalid: Initial stock must be a number >= 0
excel.toastFileEmpty: The file is empty or has no products.
excel.toastReadExcelFailed: Could not read the file. Check that it is CSV or Excel (.xlsx).
excel.toastNoValidRows: There is no valid data to save.
excel.toastSaveFailed: Failed to save products to the database.

inventoryCsv.title: Inventory CSV
inventoryCsv.subtitle: Download the current inventory or upload a file to add incoming goods or correct the count, keeping office and home apart.
inventoryCsv.exportDesc: A CSV with every product: stock at the office, at home, total, cost, price and value. Open it in Excel.
inventoryCsv.modeEntryDesc: Adds what arrived. Recalculates the average cost and is kept in the stock-in history.
inventoryCsv.modeCountDesc: Replaces stock with what you counted. Differences are saved as a stock adjustment.
inventoryCsv.step1: 1. Download the form and fill it in
inventoryCsv.formEntryDesc: It lists all your products with empty "Office in" and "Home in" columns. Write how much arrived at each place and leave the rest blank.
inventoryCsv.formCountDesc: This is your current inventory. Change the "Office" and "Home" numbers to what you counted; anything left as is stays untouched.
inventoryCsv.locationHint: Your own file also works with SKU, Quantity and Location (Office or Home) columns, one row per place.
inventoryCsv.nothingToApply: The file has no changes to apply.
inventoryCsv.missingColumns: Columns not found: {{columns}}. Use the downloaded form or check the headers.
inventoryCsv.stockFileWarning: This file looks like the exported inventory (it has a "Total" column). In incoming mode those quantities are ADDED to what you already have. To correct the count, switch to "Correct the count".
inventoryCsv.truncated: The file has too many rows; only the first 2000 were read.
inventoryCsv.errorNotFound: No product has that SKU, barcode or name
inventoryCsv.errorNoProduct: The row has no SKU or product name
inventoryCsv.errorUnmanaged: This product does not track stock
inventoryCsv.errorCostRequired: Unit cost missing (the product has no cost)
inventoryCsv.errorDuplicate: The {{place}} count appears more than once
